title: Polish the event feed page
body:
As a User, I want the event feed to feel polished and responsive so I have a smooth browsing experience.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Empty state is displayed when no events match the current filters
- [ ] Loading skeletons are shown while events are being fetched
- [ ] Sort options are available (e.g. date ascending, newest first)
- [ ] Layout follows the Figma design and is responsive / mobile-friendly

title: Display average rating on event cards
body:
As a User, I want to see the average rating on event cards in the feed so I can quickly gauge event quality.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Average rating is displayed on each event card (e.g. star icon + number)
- [ ] Events with no reviews show an appropriate fallback (e.g. no rating displayed)
- [ ] Layout follows the Figma design and is responsive / mobile-friendly

title: Implement Nominatim geocoding backend service
body:
As a Developer, I want a backend service that converts addresses to coordinates via Nominatim so events can be placed on a map.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A geocoding service calls the Nominatim API with an address string and returns latitude/longitude
- [ ] Results are cached locally to avoid hitting Nominatim rate limits during development
- [ ] The service is available for use in the event creation/update flow
- [ ] Error cases are handled (address not found, Nominatim unavailable)

title: Add map preview to the event creation form
body:
As a User, I want to see a map preview on the event creation form so I can visually confirm the event location.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] On desktop, a map preview area is shown on the event creation form with a placeholder for now
- [ ] On mobile, the map preview is not displayed
- [ ] Layout follows the Figma design and is responsive / mobile-friendly

title: Enable join and leave event functionality
body:
As a User, I want to join and leave events so I can manage my participation.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The Join Event button on the event details page is enabled and functional (previously disabled with "Coming soon")
- [ ] Joining calls POST /api/events/{id}/join and updates the participant list
- [ ] Leaving calls DELETE /api/events/{id}/leave and updates the participant list
- [ ] Age restriction and max participant errors from the backend are communicated to the user
- [ ] The button reflects the user's current participation status
- [ ] Layout follows the Figma design and is responsive / mobile-friendly

title: Display event status visual states
body:
As a User, I want to see clear visual indicators of an event's status so I can tell at a glance if it is active, cancelled, or completed.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Event cards and the event details page show a visual indicator for active, cancelled, and completed statuses
- [ ] Cancelled and completed events are visually distinct from active ones
- [ ] Layout follows the Figma design and is responsive / mobile-friendly

title: Implement submit review form
body:
As a User, I want to submit a review for a completed event I attended so I can share my feedback.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A review form is shown on the event details page for completed events the user participated in
- [ ] The form includes a star rating (1–5) and an optional comment field
- [ ] On submission, the review is created via POST /api/events/{id}/reviews
- [ ] The form is hidden if the user has already reviewed the event
- [ ] Layout follows the Figma design and is responsive / mobile-friendly

title: Implement review prompt modal on login
body:
As a User, I want to be prompted to review completed events I attended so I don't forget to leave feedback.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] On login, pending reviews are fetched from GET /api/users/me/pending-reviews
- [ ] If pending reviews exist, a modal prompts the user to leave a review
- [ ] The modal allows the user to submit or dismiss each pending review
- [ ] Layout follows the Figma design and is responsive / mobile-friendly

title: Implement theming and theme picker
body:
As a User, I want a new app theme and the ability to switch themes so the app looks polished and suits my preference.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A new custom theme is implemented across the app (colors, typography, component styles)
- [ ] A theme picker is available in the navbar allowing the user to switch themes
- [ ] The selected theme persists across sessions (e.g. stored in localStorage)
- [ ] Layout follows the Figma design and is responsive / mobile-friendly

title: Add toast notifications for key actions
body:
As a User, I want to see confirmation messages when I perform important actions so I know they succeeded.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Toast / snackbar notifications are shown on: event creation, event joining, event leaving, event cancellation/deletion, review submission, and profile updates
- [ ] Error toasts are shown when these actions fail
- [ ] Toasts auto-dismiss after a reasonable duration
- [ ] Layout follows the Figma design and is responsive / mobile-friendly

title: Polish admin panel
body:
As an Admin, I want a polished admin panel so I can efficiently moderate the platform.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Flag counts are displayed per event
- [ ] Bulk dismiss option is available for flags
- [ ] Moderation actions (edit/cancel event) are accessible from the admin panel
- [ ] Only users with the ADMIN role can access the panel
- [ ] Layout follows the Figma design and is responsive / mobile-friendly

title: Fix missing form validation on event creation
body:
The event creation form does not validate inputs on the frontend. Users can submit invalid data with no feedback.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Required fields show validation errors before submission
- [ ] Error messages are displayed inline next to the relevant fields

title: Fix extra character in filters card
body:
An extra ">" character is displayed in the filters card on the feed page.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The stray ">" is removed from the filters card

title: Fix login form error messages
body:
The login form shows a generic "bad request" message instead of the actual validation errors returned by the backend.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Login form displays the error messages received from the backend response
- [ ] Messages are user-friendly and shown inline or as a form-level error

title: Redirect logged-in users away from landing page
body:
A logged-in user can navigate to the landing page instead of being redirected to the home/feed page.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Authenticated users accessing the landing page are redirected to the home/feed page

title: Reduce space used by events section on profile page
body:
The "Your events" section on the profile page takes up too much vertical space.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The events section uses a more compact layout per the Figma design

title: Update navbar with all app routes
body:
As a User, I want the navbar to include links to all sections of the app so I can navigate to any page.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Navbar includes links to all current routes (feed, create event, profile, admin panel for admins)
- [ ] Active route is visually highlighted
- [ ] Layout follows the Figma design and is responsive / mobile-friendly

title: Make event cards proper router links
body:
Event cards in the feed use (click) handlers instead of router links. There are no hover animations and no native link behavior (open in new tab, etc.).

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Event cards use routerLink instead of (click) handlers
- [ ] Hover animation is added to event cards
- [ ] Standard link behavior works (e.g. middle-click to open in new tab)
